title: API surface
description: The line formats of conformance/api-surface/ (Story 3.5, AD-15, PRD §5.1). <component>.jsonl is generated by bun run oracle:api-surface (tools/oracle/api-surface.php, PHP Reflection in the Oracle image): one #/$defs/surface line per public Upstream class, interface, trait or enum, its public members declared by itself (trait-imported members count, inherited ones do not), and each user function, sorted by fqcn, then kind (declaration or function, case, constant, property, method), then member, by UTF-16 code unit. additions.jsonl (#/$defs/addition) and exceptions.jsonl (#/$defs/exception) are Protected, hand-written through Maintainer review, sorted by component, fqcn, member, without duplicates; every line cites its reason.

name.description: A PHP identifier: a member, parameter or namespace segment name.

fqcn.description: A fully qualified class or function name, without a leading backslash.

type.description: PHP's type string, as ReflectionType prints it, or null when untyped.

component.description: A Component: a name in tools/scaffold/packages.jsonl.

parameter.description: One parameter, in declaration order. nullable is allowsNull() (untyped counts as nullable). default is null when there is none, else PHP source: a constant name, `new …` as Reflection prints it, `Enum::Case` (the enum's FQCN without a leading backslash), or a compact literal.

declaration.description: A class, interface, trait or enum. stubbed lists the missing types the exporter defined as empty stubs to load it. parents lists, sorted, every class it extends (its whole parent chain) and every interface it implements or extends, directly or inherited, PHP's built-in interfaces and stubs included, traits not.

constant.description: A class constant or an enum case.

function.description: A user function declared under the repository's src/.

surface.description: One line of conformance/api-surface/<component>.jsonl, keys in the order of its kind's definition.

member.description: The member name, or null for the class, interface, trait, enum or function itself.

addition.description: One line of additions.jsonl: a member the Xaravel package exports that Upstream lacks. citation is the FR or DIV clause that specifies it (spine AD-15).

exception.description: One line of exceptions.jsonl: an Upstream member the Xaravel package does not export. citation is the DIV clause or the deferred:<item> that explains it (spine AD-15).
